definitions.explanation: To make an effort to do something.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{方法|ほうほう}を{試|こころ}みる。
{説得|せっとく}を{試|こころ}みた。
{挑戦|ちょうせん}を{試|こころ}みる。

notes:
{試|こころ}みる means to try or attempt.

DON'T CONFUSE:
- {試|こころ}みる: to try (formal, deliberate attempt)
- {試|ため}す: to test, try out
- やってみる: to try doing (casual)

RELATED:
- {試|こころ}み: attempt, trial
